---
title: "Preprocess Owens BCR sequences"
---

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(Biostrings)
library(igblastr)

FASTA_DIR <- data_path("owens/MS Repertoire Fasta Files")
OUT_CSV   <- data_path("owens/owens_sequences.csv")
```

```{r read-fasta}
fasta_files <- list.files(FASTA_DIR, pattern = "\\.fa$",
                          full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Found %d FASTA files\n", length(fasta_files)))

read_fasta_to_tibble <- function(f) {
  fa <- readDNAStringSet(f)
  tibble(
    file = str_remove(f, fixed(paste0(FASTA_DIR, "/"))),  # relative to the FASTA folder
    header = names(fa),
    sequence = as.character(fa)
  )
}

all_sequences <- map_dfr(fasta_files, read_fasta_to_tibble)
cat(sprintf("Total sequences: %s\n", scales::comma(nrow(all_sequences))))
```

```{r igblast}
use_germline_db("IMGT-202531-1.Homo_sapiens.IGH+IGK+IGL")
use_c_region_db("_IMGT.human.IGH+IGK+IGL.202412")

seqs <- DNAStringSet(all_sequences$sequence)

igblast_results <- igblastn(
  query = seqs,
  organism = "human",
  outfmt = "AIRR"
)

annotated <- all_sequences %>%
  dplyr::rename(original_sequence = sequence) %>%
  bind_cols(igblast_results)

cat(sprintf("Annotated: %s sequences\n", scales::comma(nrow(annotated))))
annotated %>% count(locus, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r filter-and-clip}
# V-J clip and filter to match the main classifier pipeline
owens <- annotated %>%
  filter(productive == TRUE) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  mutate(sequence = str_sub(sequence, v_sequence_start, j_sequence_end)) %>%
  filter(str_count(sequence, "N") < 1) %>%
  select(sequence_id, file, header, locus,
         v_call, d_call, j_call, c_call,
         junction, sequence,
         productive, complete_vdj)

cat(sprintf("After filtering: %d productive IGH sequences (V-J clipped, no N's)\n",
            nrow(owens)))

owens %>% count(complete_vdj)

```

```{r write-output}
write_csv(owens, OUT_CSV)
cat(sprintf("Written to %s\n", OUT_CSV))
```
